import pandas as pd
import scipy.stats as stats

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/meta-regression_study_data_heterogeneity_in_replication_projects.csv')

# Extract the relevant columns
original_citations_avg = df['author_citations_avg.o']
replication_citations_avg = df['author_citations_avg.r']

original_citations_max = df['author_citations_max.o']
replication_citations_max = df['author_citations_max.r']

# Perform descriptive statistics
descriptive_stats_avg = df[['author_citations_avg.o', 'author_citations_avg.r']].describe()
descriptive_stats_max = df[['author_citations_max.o', 'author_citations_max.r']].describe()

# Perform t-tests
t_test_avg = stats.ttest_ind(original_citations_avg, replication_citations_avg)
t_test_max = stats.ttest_ind(original_citations_max, replication_citations_max)

descriptive_stats_avg, descriptive_stats_max, t_test_avg, t_test_max
